name: Cyrus Finance CyrusTreasury spot-priced LP withdrawal
summary: CyrusTreasury paid USDT exits through withdrawUSDTFromAny, which sized the PancakeSwap V3 liquidity to remove from the pool's spot slot0 price and then collected both tokens of the removed liquidity to the claimant. The attacker pushed the ETH/USDT price into the position's range with flash-loaned ETH, exited a small position, received most of the treasury's liquidity, and swapped back.
notes: CyrusTreasury is an immutable deployment; the owner's later setTokenIdByIndex only chose which registered position the defect could drain (loss size), so it is not a reset.

Loss is the USDT backing of the liquidity the exit removed (the position was out of range, all USDT), less the USDT the exit legitimately owed; the ETH it paid out was bought from the attacker's own sale in the same tx. The protocol's performance-fee leg is excluded.
